body: chrome-ext store (apps/chrome-ext/src/app/store.ts, zustand) persisted IDB keys (KEYS ~165): lib:files, lib:folders (handles STRIPPED before persist), lib:recent (max 20), lib:active, lib:tabs, lib:theme, lib:ui (UIPrefs incl sidebar/toc/fullscreen/readingMode/autoRefresh). Memory-only (reset on reload): sessionRev, activeFileId, openTabs, scrollTarget{fileId,line,rev}, revealRequest, scopedSearchRequest. Live FSA handles live in sessionHandles.ts; persistent handles in IDB keys fsa:handle:<id> / fsa:loose:<fileId>.
